metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and Valorant said ‘Here’s your 1 kill, don’t ask why’
metadata.description:
Me: no clue what just happened
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-round
Valorant: handing out 1 free kill like it’s a bug
Click if your aim’s just as confused!

Tap if you’ve ever gotten a kill you swear you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
